title: Reproducible AI Development Environment
description: Build a reproducible local AI development environment from scratch: pinned Python tooling, Git workflow, Dockerized dependencies, automated tests, linting, and CI that runs the whole pipeline from a clean checkout in one command.
learningObjectives: Isolate project dependencies with a pinned environment file
Automate formatting, linting, and testing through a single entry point
Run identical setup in Docker and on the host
Prove reproducibility with a CI workflow that starts from a clean clone
Document the environment so a teammate can reproduce it in under 10 minutes

deliverables.title: Setup documentation
deliverables.description: Setup steps verified from a clean clone.

deliverables.title: CI run passing tests and lint

milestones.title: Pin the Python environment
milestones.objective: Create a fully pinned environment (pyproject/requirements lock or conda lock) with the ML basics installed.
milestones.expectedOutput: Environment resolves identically from lock file with no unpinned transitive deps.

milestones.title: Match host and Docker environments
milestones.objective: Containerize the environment so `make test` produces the same output inside and outside Docker.
milestones.expectedOutput: Dockerfile + compose config; test output identical in both targets.

milestones.title: Add CI from clean clone
milestones.objective: GitHub Actions workflow installs, lints, and tests from a fresh clone on every push.
milestones.expectedOutput: Green CI run visible on the repository.

milestones.title: Write the 10-minute handoff
milestones.objective: Document setup so a reviewer reproduces the environment unaided within 10 minutes.
milestones.expectedOutput: README with exact commands and troubleshooting notes.

architecture: Repository root = single source of truth: lock file, Makefile, Dockerfile, CI
Makefile targets: setup, lint, test, docker-test
CI mirrors the Makefile targets so local and hosted runs cannot drift
constraints: No manual dependency edits outside the lock file
No secrets committed; use .env.example as the template
hints: Time yourself reproducing from scratch; if it exceeds 10 minutes, keep automating

requiredEvidence.description: Public repository containing the environment and automation.
Link to a passing CI run (Actions URL).
